title: AIR CONDITIONING-EVAPORATOR & REFRIGERANT CONTROL VALVE
summary: Air conditioning (C60) evaporator & blower assembly (the A/C box on the passenger-side firewall in the engine compartment) and the expansion/refrigerant control valve, drain tube and O-rings. The evaporator case is held to the dash panel with nuts [1] on production studs (top, bottom bracket and inside at View A) and nut [2] near the clip, sealed to the dash with 55b sealer; the valve is clamped in bracket [10] with screw [11], and screw [12] goes into a tapping plate in the dash panel. All refrigerant line joints take new O-rings.

materials.where: evaporator case flange against the dash panel (bead min .38 dia.)
system charge, tag at the valve [6] in View A

fastening.note: Nuts [1] go on production studs sticking out of the dash panel: at the top of the evaporator/blower case, at the case's lower bracket (marked A), and from inside the dash at View A (marked A). See note A for residual torque.

fastening.to: stud at the side of the evaporator case, next to the clip
fastening.note: Nut [2] on a stud at the case's side flange beside the clip.
Sealer 55b bead along the evaporator case flange against the dash; bead .38 min dia.

fastening.to: drain nipple under the evaporator case
fastening.note: Drain tube [4] slips onto the case nipple, held by clamp [5].
View A: screw [11] goes through the ear of bracket [10], which wraps around valve [6].

fastening.to: tapping plate in dash panel (Sheet A5)
fastening.note: View A: screw [12] goes into the tapping plate on the dash panel next to the valve.

fastening.to: evaporator inlet tube (top) and line to fitting & muffler (bottom)
fastening.note: O-rings [9] at both ends of valve [6]; top joint torque 6, bottom joint torque 8.

fastening.to: equalizer line and liquid bleed line
fastening.note: O-rings [7] at the equalizer line (torque 5) and liquid bleed line connections.
O-ring [8] at the receiver-dehydrator line joint (torque 7).

notes: [A] Tighten nut to installation torque; residual torque on the nut must be at least 10 lbs in after 24 hours.
NOTE: At time of application, sealer bead must be .38 dia. minimum, measured perpendicular to flange.
notes_internal: Item 1 pn: hole punch damages the 3rd digit; visible '94' + '9845'.

Tube-nut torque triangles 3 (evap tube at valve top), 5 (equalizer line), 6 (valve upper port), 7 (receiver line), 8 (line to fitting & muffler) point at fittings, not callouts; positions recorded in fastening notes as best read.
Screw [12]: drawn going into the dash tapping plate; which part it holds is not clear.
Bracket [10] mounting to the car not shown beyond screw [11].
'SCREW (See duct atch)' and 'CLIP' labels have no callouts.
Material 55b/150a legend letters B/C; A is the torque note.
